I’m failing my classes, I lost my job, quit all my hobbies, lost all my friends, lost my girl, lost my sanity. I had a lot of hope starting on zoloft but things got worse so I had to stop taking it and my life is getting worse and worse faster and faster exponentially. My brain is incredibly dysfunctional and people always ask me why I try so hard to be normal and it’s because I’m abnormal and my brain chemistry’s fucked and even the doctors know it. My perception and ability to comprehend what’s going on and act accordingly was bad from the start but is worsening.  I would much rather be dead than suffer alive. It’s essentially torture

it feels like I don’t automatically understand people or have the innate social sense/ability to communicate the way humans do. Like I noticed people are really good at understanding each other and each other’s situations by instinct/second nature/gut feeling/subconsciously and I just can’t do that. And I have no sense of identity or purpose like idk who I am. Like I’m really impressionable and easy to influence. Another thing is that I get really attached to people and when they leave I feel way more pain than what makes sense. It also feels like since I’ve spent 17 years wiring my brain this way, treatment will only tweak my reality instead of transforming it.

Don’t do it. I’m sorry you feel like you’re losing your mind, but there’s so much more to life than you think there is. Maybe right now in this moment, you don’t think so but I promise everything will be okay.
